transcript: This is Agropulse Open Like. I'm your host Jeff Dally. Our guest this week is Massachusetts' 2nd District Representative Jim McGovern. AgriPulse OpenBike continues with Congressman Jim McGovern, next. Healthy Hives, a Be Health Research Initiative led by the Crop Science Division of Bayer and the Nonprofit Project IFAS has been extended through 2023. This is Agropulse OpenMic. Massachusetts Representative Jim McGovern serves as an influential member of the House Agriculture Committee and has been a champion for hunger and nutrition programs. McGovern says people and businesses in his district are suffering in the struggling economy. He doesn't think the current COVID aid proposal is nearly enough.
